m: अव-गाढ mfn. immersed, bathed, plunged into (acc. [R.; Śak.]; loc. [Āp.; MBh. i, 5300]; rarely gen. [R. iv, 43, 32]; often in comp. [Śak.; Mṛcch.])
that in which one bathes, MBh. iii, 8236

curdling (as blood), Suśr.

m: अव-गाढ—वत् mfn. bathing, plunging, diving.

a: अवगाह् — {c1c} A. 1 (a) To bathe oneself in, plunge into, dive into; with acc. or loc.; तमोपहंत्रीं तमसां वगाह्य R. 14. 76; अन्यमवकाशमवगाहिष्ये V. 4; स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेत्यर्थं जलं Y. 1. 272; Bk. 6. 29, 16. 38. (b) To go deep into, be absorbed into (fig.); अमात्यराक्षसेनाप्यनवगाहितयार्यचाणक्यस्य चरितमवगाहितुमिच्छसि Mu. 6. --2 To enter, penetrate, fully pervade; विमानशृंगाण्यवगाहमानः (घोषः) Ku. 7. 40; पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी वगाह्य Ku. 1. 1; पूर्वापरसमुद्रावगाढः Ś. 7; Mk. 2; see अवगाढ also. --Caus. To bathe, cause to bathe.

Til. {1} --3 (fig.) Mastering, learning, studying completely; सकलशास्त्रावगाहगंभीरबुद्धिः K. 56. --4 A place of bathing. --5 A bucket.

m: अव-गाहन n. immersion, bathing.
अव-गाहित mfn. that in which one bathes (as a river), MBh. iii, 8230 and xiii, 1821.

a: अवगै — {c1c} P. 1 To sing in a discorddant tone. --2 To sing deprecatingly, satirize in a song, revile, reproach (mostly used in p. p.).

अव-गीथ n. early recitation at a sacrifice, L.
अव-गीर्ण mfn. swallowed down, Pat.

अव-गीत n. satire in song, blame, censure, L.
a: अवगीत — p. p. 1 Sung in a discordant tone, sung badly --2 Reproached, abused, censured; अनवगीतः परिचयः U. 2. 2; अवगीतां गमिते दशामिमां Ki. 2. 7; सोढावगीतप्रथमायुधस्य 17. 28; Śi. 11. 10. --3 Wicked, vile. --4 Satirized in a song. --5 Seen frequently, well-known (मुहुर्दृष्ट). --तं 1 A satire in song, derision. --2 Reproach, blame. --3 Bad or discordant singing.

महद्राज्यं चावगीतं जन्ये स्याद्गर्हिते त्रिषु। श्वेतं रूप्येऽपि रजतं हेम्नि रूप्ये सिते त्रिषु॥
महद्राज्यं चावगीतं जन्ये स्याद्गर्हिते त्रिषु। श्वेतं रूप्येऽपि रजतं हेम्नि रूप्ये सिते त्रिषु॥

अव-गलित mfn. fallen down, BhP.

अव-√ गम् -गच्छति (Subj. -गच्छात्; ind.p. -गत्य, RV. vi, 75, 5; Ved. Inf. अवगन्तोस्, TS.) to go down, descend to (acc. or loc.), RV.; AV.; (with acc.) to come to, visit, approach, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to reach, obtain, TS.; AitBr.; to get power or influence, TS.; to go near, undertake, MBh. v, 740; to hit upon, think of, conceive, learn, know, understand, anticipate, assure one's self, be convinced; to recognize, consider, believe any one (acc.) to be (acc.), MBh. iii, 2483, &c. : Caus. P. (3. pl. -गमयन्ति; Imper. 2. sg. -गमय) to bring near, procure, AV. iii, 3, 6; TS.; to cause to know, teach, Mālav. &c.
a: अवगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go down, descend; अंजः समुद्रमवजग्मुरापः Rv. 1. 32. 2. --2 To come to, visit, go near. --3 To reach, obtain. --4 (a) To know, learn, understand, think, believe; कृतापराधमिवावगच्छति आत्मानं K. 203; मामेवमवगच्छति V. 2; कथं शांतमित्यभिहिते श्रांत इत्यवगच्छति मूर्खः Mk. 1; न खल्ववगच्छामि, परस्तादवगम्यत एव Ś. 1; तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंशसंभवं Bg. 10. 41; R. 8. 88; Bk. 5. 81. (b) To consider, regard, look upon. --5 To assure oneself, be convinced. --Caus. 1 To bring near. --2 To inform oneself of, find out, know; तावदेतेभ्यः प्रियाप्रवृत्तिरवगमयितव्या V. 4. --3 To inform, cause to know, teach; पुरुषविशेषमवगमयति Mu. 5; सर्वमिदं पित्रोरवगमय्य Dk. --4 To indicate, show; संनाहोयं साहसमवगमयति Dk. 96; Bk. 10. 53, 62.

अव-गर्हित mfn. despised, R. ii, 21, 19 (v.l. गर्हित).

a: अवग्राहः — 1 Breaking, separation. --2 Impediment; अवग्राहस्ते भूयात् Sk. --3 A curse; see अवग्रह.

अव-√ ग्रह् -गृह्णाति (Pot. -गृह् णीयात्) to let loose, let go, Lāṭy.; to keep back from (abl.), impede, stop, PBr.; Car.; Kād.; to divide, Suśr.; (in Gr.) to separate (as words or parts of a word), ŚāṅkhŚr. &c. (cf. अव-ग्राहम् below); to perceive (with one's senses), distinguish, BhP.; Suśr. : Caus. (ind.p. -ग्राह्य) to separate (into pieces).
a: अवग्रह् — {c9c} U. 1 To let loose, let go (as reins). --2 To divide, separate (as words or parts of words); पितृपाणमित्यत्र हि पितृ पाणमित्यृकारोऽवगृह्यते P. VIII. 2. 46 Com. --3 To break off, discontinue; to distinguish, discriminate, discern. --4 To punish, chastise; मंदोपि नाम न महानवगृह्य साध्यः Śi. 5. 49. --5 To seize, choke; गद्गदिकावगृह्यमाणकंठा K. 307, 328. --6 To capture, take in possession, overpower; स्वामिनमवशमवगृह्णंति Dk. 157; Dk. 32; Ve. 46. --7 To oppose, resist, hinder, obstruct. --8 To lay hold of (with the feet). --Caus. To knead, make dough.

m: अव-ग्रह m. separation of the component parts of a compound, or of the stem and certain suffixes and terminations (occurring in the Pada text of the Vedas), Prāt. &c.
the mark or the interval of such a separation, Prāt.
the syllable or letter after which the separation occurs, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. viii, 4, 26, the chief member of a word so separated, Prāt.
obstacle, impediment, restraint, PBr. &c.
mark of the elision of an initial अ
(= वर्ष प्रतिबन्ध, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 51) drought, Ragh.; Kathās.

an imprecation or term of abuse, L.
an elephant's forehead, L.

a: अवग्रहः — 1 Separation of the component parts of a compound, or of other grammatical forms. --2 The mark or interval of such a separation; समासेऽवग्रहो थस्वसमकालः. --3 The syllable or letter after which such separation occurs; ऋदवग्रहात् P. VIII. 4. 26. --4 A hiatus, absence of sandhi (as in धिक् तां च तं च मदनं च इमां च मां च instead of चेमांच) Bh. 2. 2. --5 The mark (') used to mark the elision of अ after ए and ओ. --6 Withholding of rain, drought, failure of rain; वृष्टिर्भवति शस्यानामवग्रहविशोषिणां R. 1. 62; रावणावग्रहक्लांतमिति वागमृतेन सः 10. 48; नभोनभस्ययोर्वृष्टिमवग्रह इवांतरे 12. 29; वृषेव सीतां तदवग्रहक्षतां Ku. 5. 61. --7 An obstacle, impediment, hindrance, restraint; संसार˚ Māl. 1 the bonds or fetters of worldly existence; प्रसह्य रक्षोभिरवग्रहं च Rām.; see अनवग्रह and निरवग्रह. --8 A herd of elephants. --9 The forehead of an elephant. --10 Nature, original temperament. --11 A sort of knowledge, a false idea. --12 Punishment (opp. अनुग्रह); अनुग्रहावग्रहयोर्विधाता Śi. 1. 71. --13 An imprecation, a term of abuse. --14 An iron hook with which elephants are driven.

अवगुंडित — a. Pounded, ground.
